question: In a heap stored as an array, where are the children of the item at index 4?
explanation: Children of index i are at 2i + 1 and 2i + 2: 9 and 10. The parent of i is at (i − 1) / 2 rounded down.

question: You need the 10 largest numbers from a stream of a million. Which heap keeps the work smallest?
options: A max-heap of all million numbers
A min-heap of size 10, popping its smallest when it grows past 10
A sorted array of all numbers
explanation: The min-heap's root is the weakest of the current top 10, so it is the one to drop. Each number costs O(log 10): O(n log k) overall.

question: What does a min-heap NOT give you quickly?
explanation: A heap only orders parents against children, not left against right, so finding an arbitrary value still means checking up to every item: O(n).
